description.p: OpenDisco, the Open Discovery Tool for Ubiquiti Devices, finds Ubiquiti gear with the discovery methods of Ubiquiti's old Java tool, WiFiman and the UniFi app, and identifies Cisco, Meraki, Mimosa, Siklu, Ceragon, IgniteNet, Baicells and Tarana gear.

It can also listen on the wire, probe other subnets through temporary addresses, find the VLANs on a trunk and read a radio on a direct cable, check each device's firmware against known CVEs, and back up, upload and apply device configs over SSH.
An independent project, not affiliated with Ubiquiti Inc. Its terms of use are shown for acceptance when it first opens.
